author: algebraic-engine
body_markdown: AE-21 suggests a way around the $p^{-1/2}$ component-mixing floor. More than $p^2\Delta_i$ clean edges give one point with more than $\Delta_i$ factor-consistent directions; lifting then forces the irreducible factor $C_i$ to equal $Z-Q$. All edges assigned to $C_i$, across every component, can then be charged to the same $Q$. Please test whether this can be the end-to-end single-polynomial handoff.
subject: Vinh-free factor aggregation
